fields.name: LoadedEventName
fields.evidence: Toolkit constructor builds a FixedString at +0x88. bg3.exe+0x1BB5500 (~ PointSoundTrigger::Play) loads the sound only when +0x88 is empty and EventName (+0x8C) is set, then copies EventName into +0x88 (FUN_14412e090); ecl::PointSoundTrigger::Stop (bg3.exe+0x1BB56D0) calls ResourceManager::UnloadSound(+0x88, +0x9E) and resets it to -1. Live: -1 in all samples.

fields.name: EventName

fields.name: ActivationRadius

fields.name: LoadedSoundFlag
fields.evidence: Constructor writes 16-bit 0 over +0x9E/+0x9F. Play (bg3.exe+0x1BB5500) stores bit 1 of byte +0x39 of the sound resource here and Stop passes it as the bool argument of ResourceManager::UnloadSound - remembers how the loaded sound must be unloaded. Exact meaning of that bit unknown. Live 0.

fields.name: field_9F
fields.evidence: Zeroed by the constructor's 16-bit store at +0x9E. Live 0 or 1.

fields.name: UseOcclusion
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessor UseOcclusion at +0xA0; constructor writes 1; live 1.

fields.name: _PadA1
fields.evidence: Not written by the constructor; C++ object ends at 0xA1 (sizeof 0xA8). Live garbage (0x00 / 0xFF bytes).

fields.name: field_A8
fields.evidence: Beyond the C++ object; live 0, 0x1B or 0xFFFFFFFF in the low dword. Same trailing 8 bytes as in the other ecl triggers.
